components.name: AiSidebar
components.doc: An assistant panel docked beside the page. It slides in on a spring and pushes the page aside; in a narrow container it slides over the page behind a scrim instead. Inside: a header, a message list that follows new messages, suggestion chips and a prompt box that grows with the text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, Escape closes.

defaults.title: "Assistant"
defaults.emptyText: "Ask about this page, or start from a suggest…

members.name: id
members.doc: Stable id of the message.

members.name: role
members.doc: Who wrote it.

members.name: content
members.doc: The message. Text, or any node (a streaming response, a card).

members.name: children
members.doc: The page the assistant docks beside.

members.name: messages
members.doc: The conversation, oldest first.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the panel is open (controlled).

members.name: defaultOpen
members.doc: Whether the panel starts open (uncontrolled).

members.name: onOpenChange
members.doc: Called when the launcher, the close button or Escape opens or closes the panel.

members.name: onSend
members.doc: Called with the trimmed text when the person sends a prompt or picks a suggestion.

members.name: pending
members.doc: Shows the thinking indicator after the last message and holds the send button.

members.name: suggestions
members.doc: Prompt ideas shown as chips above the prompt box. Picking one sends it.

members.name: title
members.doc: Heading of the panel.

members.name: subtitle
members.doc: Short line under the heading, such as what the assistant can see.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Placeholder of the prompt box.

members.name: emptyText
members.doc: Text shown while the conversation is empty.

members.name: side
members.doc: Side the panel docks on.

members.name: width
members.doc: Width of the docked panel in pixels.

members.name: overlayBelow
members.doc: Below this container width in pixels the panel slides over the page instead of pushing it aside.

members.name: launcher
members.doc: Shows a floating button that opens the panel while it is closed. Turn it off when the page has its own trigger.

members.name: className
members.doc: Class name added to the root element.
